comment: mon.c newcham() on a level of dungeon -1: a chameleon made with ^G takes its first form in makemon(), and newcham() calls makemon.c newmonhp(), whose adj_lev() reaches dungeon.c level_difficulty(); builds_up() finds no branch for dungeon -1 and calls impossible() before newcham() goes on. A debug-mode dwarvish Valkyrie improvises on a wished wooden flute, wishes for a magic portal, which keeps maketrap()'s dst of {-1, -1}, and steps back onto it, arriving on a level of dungeon -1 (as recipes/mkroom.c/mkundead-cursed-bell-dungeon-minus-one does), then makes the chameleon. The seed, date and character were chosen independently; the seed is the first tried.
